GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out rounding the home turn & was awkwardly placed on heels. When qst re leading, rdr std at its most recent starts the gelding had failed to travel & became disconnected from the field. She added that when she identified that the tempo was slow, she made the decision to allow her mount to stride forward near the 1600m in an attempt to obtain the lead. She further added that once she was positioned to the outside of the leader, that runner kept her racing in a wide position without cover & made her place her mount under more pressure than she would have liked to obtain the outright lead.
Shifted in on jumping and bumped with another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok bustled, no early speed, settled clear last 12+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. When qst rdr std that despite urging his mnt along, it failed to muster speed in the early stages & added that despite continuing to pressure his mnt throughout the middle stages, it failed to tack onto the rest of the field. Added passing 300m, when there was no longer an opportunity to improve his mount’s position, he elected to desist from riding it out thereafter. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr was advised that the gelding must barrier trial to the satisfaction of Stewards before being permitted to race again. Passed trial Forbes 11/10.
